FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Contact: Jared DeLoof, Ada County Democrats Chair, chair@adademocrats.org , 814-574-7566 Ada County Democrats Raise $7,175 in Less Than 36 Hours to Support Boise TSA Workers Abandoned by Republican Congress Local federal workers describe going weeks without pay, door dashing after shifts to buy food, and lives put on hold as GOP votes down funding eight times BOISE, Idaho — In a stunning display of community solidarity, the Ada County Democratic Party raised $7,175 in less than 36 hours to purchase gift cards for the 70 members of AFGE TSA Local 366 at Boise Airport — workers who have gone more than six weeks without a paycheck while Republican members of Congress have voted eight times to reject the funding that would pay them. When Ada County Democrats delivered the gift cards, the workers' stories were heartbreaking — and infuriating. These are not abstract statistics. These are Boise neighbors. They are behind on rent. They are door dashing after their TSA shifts just to put food on the table. Their lives are on hold — they can't book a family vacation, sign their kids up for travel sports leagues, or make any plans for the future because they don't know when their next paycheck is coming. These are dedicated public servants who show up every single day to keep our airports safe — and they are being starved out by political cruelty. "What we heard from these workers when we dropped off those gift cards broke our hearts and steeled our resolve," said Jared DeLoof, Chairman of the Ada County Democratic Party. "These are people working full shifts, doing their jobs with professionalism and dignity, and then going home to figure out how to pay rent or whether they can afford groceries. This is not an accident. This is a policy choice." The GOP's Eight Votes to Abandon These Workers

# Page 2^page=2
Republican members of Congress have now voted more than eight times to reject funding that would pay these workers — federal employees who are legally required to continue reporting to work. This is not a budget impasse. This is a deliberate strategy. Project 2025, the blueprint being systematically implemented by the current administration, explicitly calls for the dismantling of the TSA and its replacement with a privatized, non-union entity. The plan is not a secret. It is written down. And what is happening to Boise's TSA workers right now is its real-world preview — a deliberate effort to make federal employment so unstable, so demoralizing, and so financially devastating that workers quit, unions collapse, and the door swings open for private contractors who owe nothing to the public and everything to their shareholders. The Cruelty Is the Point — But Democrats Will Stand With Workers The Ada County Democratic Party believes this is not a bug. It is a feature. Breaking these workers financially. Stripping their union rights. Voting down their pay — again and again and again. These are not oversights or collateral damage. The cruelty is the point. The goal is to make public service untenable, crush organized labor, and hand our airports over to private interests. "Seven thousand dollars doesn't fix six weeks of unpaid wages," said Jared DeLoof. "But it says to these workers: you are not alone. We see you. We are fighting for you. And we will keep

# Page 3^page=3
fighting until every one of you get every dollar you are owed — and the union protections you deserve." The Ada County Democratic Party calls on Idaho's congressional delegation to immediately support legislation to pay these workers in full, restore TSA workers' union rights, and reject the Project 2025 agenda to privatize and dismantle the Transportation Security Administration. These workers keep us safe every day. The least we can do is make sure they can pay their rent. About the Ada County Democratic Party The Ada County Democratic Party represents Democrats across Ada County, Idaho, working to elect Democrats at every level and advocate for working families, public education, healthcare access, and democratic values.
